categories.main_business_segments: The company operates two major business segments: (1) Software and Information Technology Services, including AI/ICT Operations Management, Internet Operations, and IoT/Communications; and (2) Mobile Game Business. The software services segment provides solutions for digital transformation across telecommunications, finance, energy, and transportation sectors, while the game segment focuses on strategy-type (SLG) mobile games for global markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include Natural Language Processing (NLP), artificial intelligence and large language models, cloud computing, 5G communications, Internet of Things (IoT), and big data analytics. For game development, the company uses Unity 3D engine with URP rendering pipeline. The company has applied for 1,756 patents (1,002 authorized) and 2,093 software copyrights, with recent focus on large model training, intent recognition, and natural language processing applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include telecommunications operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom), financial institutions (major banks), energy companies, transportation sector, and government agencies. The game business serves players across 150+ countries and regions, with major markets in the United States, Japan, South Korea, mainland China, Europe, Middle East, and South America. The company serves over 300 enterprise customers in cloud services across gaming, e-commerce, smart hardware, and fintech sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Beijing. International presence includes subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Japan. Game business distribution spans 150+ countries globally, with major markets in developed countries (US, Japan, Korea, Germany, UK). Cloud services operations established in 7 Chinese cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Chengdu, Ningbo) and 40+ countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Downstream in software/services - providing solutions directly to enterprise customers; (2) Midstream in cloud services - partnering with AWS as a core-level partner; (3) Downstream in gaming - developing and publishing games directly to end consumers through app stores; (4) Upstream in IoT - manufacturing hardware devices for monitoring and communications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Innovation-driven, global layout strategy; (2) Deep integration of AI, 5G, cloud computing, big data, and IoT technologies; (3) Commercialization of large language models and generative AI; (4) Development of intelligent operations management systems; (5) Expansion of cloud services and AWS partnership; (6) Long-term operation of high-quality game products; (7) Exploration of new business directions in emerging technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: (1) Software/IT Services - direct sales of software products and technical services to enterprise customers; (2) Cloud Services - subscription and usage-based pricing for cloud infrastructure and managed services; (3) Games - in-app purchases (IAP) from players, with free-to-play model where players purchase virtual currency and items; (4) IoT/Communications - product sales and service fees; (5) Rental income from investment properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In mobile gaming, the company (through subsidiary Kemo Games) ranks 5th among Chinese game publishers by overseas revenue and 9th globally by revenue (2024). The company is positioned as a leading Chinese game developer with international competitiveness, particularly in SLG games. In software services, the company is recognized as a leader in ICT operations management with 20+ years of industry experience. The company received recognition as a 'Top 100 High-Quality Development Enterprise' from the China Software Industry Association.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2024 Revenue: 6.45 billion RMB (8.22% YoY growth); Net profit attributable to parent: 1.43 billion RMB (60.92% YoY growth); Operating cash flow: 1.65 billion RMB (52.83% YoY growth); Total assets: 8.13 billion RMB (19.54% YoY growth); Shareholder equity: 7.01 billion RMB (21.63% YoY growth). The company demonstrates strong profitability with net profit margin of 22.1% and ROE of 22.15%, showing consistent growth trajectory over three years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Integrated technology ecosystem combining AI, cloud, IoT, and 5G capabilities; (2) Long-term game product strategy with proven monetization and player retention; (3) Comprehensive enterprise solutions spanning planning, implementation, and operational support; (4) International expertise with 20+ years of overseas game operations; (5) Advanced AI capabilities including large language models and generative AI applications; (6) Trusted partnerships with major cloud providers (AWS) and telecommunications operators; (7) Proprietary technologies in NLP, intelligent operations management, and IoT communications.
